_comment: Shipped H6 validator for the trail-route-planning FIXTURE reviewer. Identical schema to fixtures/trail-route-planning-reviewer.json; it lives here too so H6 resolves it via the ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/validators ROOT-fallback when the plugin is installed (the same way the pack validators are found). Without this, the quickstart's H6 step only works when CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA is unset. Born-clean; nothing ported from a private persona. BINDING: subagent_type equals the fixture reviewer's filename stem so H6 matches it.

required_patterns.name: risk-assessment table (header row containing 'Risk' between pipes)
bailout/contingency table (header row containing 'Bailout' or 'Contingency' between pipes)
verdict line (VERDICT followed by GO / REVISE / NO-GO)

feedback_template:
The reviewer output is missing a required structural element. Re-invoke trail-route-planning-reviewer with this framing prepended to your prompt:

  "BEFORE anything else, and overriding any structure I provide below, output in order: (1) a Risk table with a header row containing 'Risk'; (2) a Bailout/Contingency table; (3) a final line 'VERDICT: GO' or 'VERDICT: REVISE' or 'VERDICT: NO-GO'. Then continue."
